title: Arrest Of Chang Dah Tsung, Alleged Commander Of The Shanghai Volunteers Red Army

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

Section 2. Station,
No. D 3489
Date April 28. 1932
Dir 28/4/32

Subject (in full) Arrest of Chang Dah Tsung (张大胜).

Made by D.E. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached report, I have
to state that Chang Dah Tsung (张大胜), alleged Commander
of the Shanghai Volunteers Red Army, has been handed over
to the Chinese Military Authorities at Lunghwa by the
Public Safety Bureau.
Particulars regarding this arrest have been
recorded by this office for further reference.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch. CeP

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3489 Station
Date April 12. 1932.）

Subject (in full) Arrest of Chang Dah Tsung

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by J.W. Robertson, Supt.

Chang Dah Tsung was arrested in a house at Kau
Ching Miao at 5 p.m. April 9.
According to the informer, this man was the Com-
mander of the Shanghai Volunteers Red Army but there is no
evidence to convict him on this charge. He is still detain-
ed in the Public Safety Bureau.
He does not appear to be an important communist.

Tan Shao-liang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：S2, Please keep in touch with
this matter and report again.
J.W.R.
12/4/32.

呈报人 谭绍良 (Tan Shao-liang) 警司 转呈人 J.W. Robertson 警司

张大胜于4月9日下午5时在曹家庙 (Kau Ching Miao) 的一所房屋内被捕。
据线人称，此人是上海义勇军红军的司令，但并无证据可据此指控定罪。他目前仍被拘留在公安局。
他似乎并非重要的共产党分子。

page_data.en:
April 12, 1932.
Morning Translation

POLITICAL

RESOLUTIONS PASSED AT NATIONAL EMERGENCY CONFERENCE.

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers publish
the following telegram from Loyang:-
At the second session of the National Emergency
Conference held on April 10 at Loyang the following resolutions
were passed:-
1) That the National Government make use of its
diplomacy and military forces permanently to resist
encroachment upon China's independence and her territorial
and administrative integrity; that no treaty which violates
this integrity be signed.
2) That all citizens throughout the country assist
the Government in observing this resolution.
The third session was held on the afternoon of
the same day at which it was resolved that China support the
Covenant of the League of Nations, the Nine Powers' Peace
Pact.
The fourth session was held at 9 a.m. April 11 at
which the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That the Government terminate the period of
Political Tutelage, convene a National Citizens Congress
and draft the Constitution.
2) That prior to the convention of this Congress,
a central citizens organization be formed to be known as
"The Assembly of Citizens' Representatives". The Assembly
will have the power to pass the Budget, to sanction the
issuing of Bonds and to confirm important treaties.
It was also resolved that all special penalties
for political offences be abolished, that the independence
of the judiciary be assured and that the people be given
freedom of speech, of holding meetings and of forming
associations, except where it menaces peace and good order.
Chang Chi urged that prior to the establishment
of a Constitutional Government, the people should help the
Kuomintang and the Government to introduce district self-
government.

COMMUNISM

The China Evening News

ARREST OF COMMANDER-IN-CHIEF OF RED ARMY.

Chang Dah Sung, Commander-in-Chief of the Red Army,
has been arrested by the Public Safety Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai on information supplied
by a certain person. The Third Department of the Bureau
has finished its investigations regarding this case.
In the afternoon of April 10, Chang Dah Sung was
sent to the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters to be dealt with.

（批：Supt. Ian,
For inquiry and report re
"A" please.
JAS）

1932年4月12日。
晨间译文

政治

全国紧急会议通过的决议。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登了来自洛阳的以下电文：
4月10日在洛阳举行的全国紧急会议第二次会议上，通过了以下决议：
1) 国民政府应利用其外交手段和军事力量，永久抵抗对中国独立及其领土和行政完整性的侵犯；不得签署任何违反此完整性的条约。
2) 全国所有公民应协助政府遵守此项决议。
同日下午举行了第三次会议，会上决定中国支持国际联盟盟约及九国和平公约。
第四次会议于4月11日上午9时举行，会上通过了以下决议：
1) 政府结束训政时期，召开国民大会，起草宪法。
2) 在此大会召开之前，成立一个中央公民组织，名为“国民代表会议”。该会议有权通过预算、批准发行公债以及确认重要条约。
会议还决定废除针对政治犯罪的所有特别刑罚，确保司法独立，并给予人民言论、集会和结社自由，除非这些行为危及和平与良好秩序。
张继敦促在建立宪政政府之前，人民应帮助国民党及政府推行地方自治。

共产主义

《字林西报晚刊》

红军总司令被捕。

红军总司令张大松 (Chang Dah Sung) 已根据某人提供的情报，被大上海市公安局逮捕。该局第三科已完成对此案的调查。
4月10日下午，张大松被送往淞沪警备司令部处理。

（批注：Ian 警司，
请就“A”项进行调查并报告。
JAS）
